qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the 'Constitution of Legislatures' in States?
e: 1. Core Concept: Formation. \n2. Logic: 168 kehta hai ki har state mein ek Legislature hoga jisme Governor aur ek ya do houses honge. \n3. Fact: Bihar mein Governor + Vidhan Sabha + Vidhan Parishad milkar Legislature bante hain.

qe: How many states in India currently have a 'Bicameral' (two-house) Legislature?
e: 1. Hook: Bihar, UP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh aur Telangana. \n2. Hustle: J&K ke UT banne ke baad ab sirf 6 states bache hain. Bihar inme se ek mukhya state hai.

qe: What is the maximum 'Strength' allowed for a State Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 170. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan ke tehat kisi bhi state Assembly mein minimum 60 aur maximum 500 members ho sakte hain. \n3. Bihar Context: Bihar Vidhan Sabha mein 243 seats hain.

qe: What is the minimum age to become a member of the 'Legislative Council' (Vidhan Parishad)?
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility. \n2. Logic: Vidhan Sabha (Lower House) ke liye 25 saal aur Vidhan Parishad (Upper House) ke liye 30 saal chahiye. \n3. Comparison: Ye Rajya Sabha ki tarah hi 30 saal ki limit rakhta hai.

qe: Who decides whether a Bill in the State Legislature is a 'Money Bill' or not?
e: 1. Power: Jaise Lok Sabha mein Speaker tay karta hai, waise hi State mein Vidhan Sabha ka Speaker final authority hota hai. \n2. Fact: Uske faisle ko kisi court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Under Article 169, who has the power to 'Abolish or Create' a Legislative Council?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: State Assembly request bhejti hai (Special Majority se), par aakhri kanoon 'Parliament' hi banati hai. \n2. Fact: Iske liye Constitutional Amendment (Art 368) ki zaroorat nahi hoti, ye simple law se hota hai.

qe: The total number of members in the Vidhan Parishad cannot exceed what fraction of the Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Core Concept: Strength Limit. \n2. Logic: Article 171 kehta hai ki Council ki strength Assembly ki total seats ke 1//3 se zyada nahi hogi. \n3. Minimum: Kam se kam 40 sadasya hone mandatory hain.

qe: What is the 'Quorum' required to hold a meeting of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
o: 1//10th or 10 members (1//10 या 10 सदस्य - जो भी अधिक हो)
e: 1. Core Concept: Minimum Attendance. \n2. Logic: Jab tak total sadasyo ka 10% ya kam se kam 10 log na hon, tab tak meeting shuru nahi ho sakti.

qe: Who elects the 'Speaker' of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
o: Members of Vidhan Sabha (विधानसभा के सदस्य)
e: 1. Election: Naye election ke baad MLAs apne beech mein se hi ek ko Speaker aur ek ko Deputy Speaker chunte hain. \n2. Role: Wo House ki maryada aur order banaye rakhta hai.

qe: Can a 'Money Bill' be introduced in the Bihar Vidhan Parishad?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Money Bill sirf 'Vidhan Sabha' mein pesh ho sakta hai (Governor ki sifaarish par). \n2. Council Power: Vidhan Parishad use sirf 14 din tak rok sakti hai, badal nahi sakti.

qe: What is the tenure of a member of the 'Legislative Council' (Vidhan Parishad)?
e: 1. Distinction: House permanent hai, par sadasya 6 saal ke liye chune jate hain. \n2. Rotation: Har 2 saal mein 1//3 sadasya retire ho jate hain.

qe: Who has the power to 'Summon' and 'Dissolve' the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Power: Article 174 ke tehat Governor hi session bulata hai aur CM ki advice par Assembly ko bhang (dissolve) kar sakta hai.

qe: How many members are nominated by the Governor to the Vidhan Parishad?
e: 1. Fields: Art, Science, Literature, Social Service aur Co-operative movement ke experts. \n2. Difference: Rajya Sabha mein 12 sadasya hote hain, par state mein total strength ka 1//6 fix hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Officer of State Legislature' like Speaker and Chairman?
e: 1. Logic: 178 Sabha ke Speaker//Deputy Speaker ke liye hai, aur 182 Parishad ke Chairman//Deputy Chairman ke liye.

qe: In Bihar, if there is a 'Deadlock' between Vidhan Sabha and Vidhan Parishad on a Non-Money Bill, what happens?
o: The decision of Vidhan Sabha prevails (विधानसभा का निर्णय मान्य होता है)
e: 1. Smart Catch: States mein 'Joint Sitting' ka koi provision nahi hai. \n2. Power: Agar Assembly dusri baar bill pass karde, toh Parishad use maximum 4 mahine (3+1) rokne ke baad pass hua hi mana jata hai.

qe: Who was the 'First Speaker' of the Bihar Legislative Assembly?
e: 1. Bihar History: Ram Dayalu Singh 1937 mein pehle Speaker bane the. \n2. Fact: Azad Bharat mein pehle Speaker 'Vindheshwari Prasad Varma' the.

qe: Which house is called the 'Upper House' of the State Legislature?
e: 1. Analogy: Jaise Centre mein Rajya Sabha hai, waise hi State mein Vidhan Parishad Upper House kehlata hai.

qe: Under Article 191, who decides on the 'Disqualification' of a member (except defection)?
o: Governor (after consulting Election Commission) (EC की सलाह पर राज्यपाल)
e: 1. Logic: Labh ke pad (Office of Profit) ya mental status par Governor, EC se puch kar faisla leta hai. \n2. Defection: Dal-badal (10th Schedule) par faisla Speaker leta hai.

qe: The 'Chairman' of Bihar Vidhan Parishad submits his resignation to?
e: 1. Rule: Chairman aur Deputy Chairman ek dusre ko apna resignation dete hain. \n2. Sabha: Speaker aur Deputy Speaker bhi ek dusre ko dete hain.

qe: What fraction of members of the Vidhan Parishad are elected by the members of the Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Core Concept: Indirect Election. \n2. Logic: Total seats ka 1//3 hissa MLAs vote karke chunte hain. \n3. Fact: Ye log Bihar Vidhan Sabha ke sadasya nahi hone chahiye jab chune jayein.

qe: Members of Vidhan Parishad elected by 'Graduates' must have graduated how many years ago?
e: 1. Core Concept: Graduate Constituency. \n2. Logic: 1//12 sadasya un logo dwara chune jate hain jo kam se kam 3 saal pehle graduate ho chuke hon. \n3. Fact: Inhe Bihar ke registered graduates vote dete hain.

qe: Which fraction of members are nominated by the Governor in the Bihar Vidhan Parishad?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 171(5). \n2. Logic: Governor 1//6 sadasyo ko Art, Science, Literature, Social Service aur Co-operative movement ke fields se nominate karta hai. \n3. Hustle: Rajya Sabha mein ye ginti '12' fix hai, par state mein '1//6 fraction' chalta hai.

qe: Who elects 1
e: 1. Core Concept: Teachers' Constituency. \n2. Logic: Wo log jo kam se kam 3 saal se secondary school ya usse upar ke level par padha rahe hon, wo 1//12 sadasya chunte hain. \n3. Fact: Bihar mein 'Teacher Voters' ka role bahut bada hota hai.

qe: What is the minimum 'Strength' fixed by the Constitution for a Vidhan Parishad?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 171. \n2. Logic: Kisi bhi haal mein Council mein 40 se kam sadasya nahi hone chahiye (Except before J&K changes). \n3. Bihar Fact: Bihar Vidhan Parishad ki total strength 75 hai.

qe: Under Article 188, every member of State Legislature must take oath before?
o: The Governor or person appointed by him (राज्यपाल या उसके द्वारा नियुक्त व्यक्ति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Oath. \n2. Logic: Governor hi shapath dilata hai, par wo aksar 'Pro-tem Speaker' ko ye kaam सौंप deta hai. \n3. Fact: Bina shapath liye sadasya house mein baith nahi sakta.

qe: Who decides on the 'Language' of the House if a member cannot express in Hindi or English?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 210. \n2. Logic: Speaker (Sabha) ya Chairman (Parishad) sadasya ko apni 'Mother Tongue' (Matribhasha) mein bolne ki ijazat de sakta hai. \n3. Bihar Context: Maithili ya Bhojpuri mein bolne ke liye Speaker ki permission chahiye hoti hai.

qe: A bill passed by Vidhan Sabha can be delayed by Vidhan Parishad for a maximum of?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Pehli baar mein 3 mahine, aur agar Sabha phir se pass karde toh 1 mahina aur. \n2. Total: Max 4 months for an Ordinary Bill. \n3. Note: Money Bill ke liye ye sirf 14 din hai.

qe: Which Article provides that 'Courts' shall not inquire into proceedings of the Legislature?
e: 1. Core Concept: Separation of Powers. \n2. Logic: House ke andar kya baatein hui ya kya procedure follow hua, ispar Court sawal nahi utha sakta. \n3. Fact: Ye Legislature ki dignity bachane ke liye hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Adjourn' (स्थगित) a daily meeting of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Smart Catch: Session khatam karna (Prorogue) Governor ka kaam hai, par din-bhar ka kaam postpone karna (Adjourn) hamesha Speaker karta hai. \n2. Logic: Speaker hi house ka manager hota hai.

qe: What is the maximum number of 'Nominated' members in Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Update: 104th Amendment Act (2020) ne Anglo-Indian nomination khatam kar diya hai. \n2. Fact: Ab saare 243 sadasya elected hote hain. Parishad mein abhi bhi nomination hota hai.

qe: A member of State Legislature remains absent for how many days without permission to lose seat?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 190. \n2. Logic: Agar koi 60 din tak bina bataye gayab rahe, toh House uski seat vacant declare kar sakta hai. \n3. Fact: Isme wo din nahi gine jate jab House 4 din se zyada ke liye adjourned ho.

qe: Who acts as the 'Custodian' of the powers and privileges of Vidhan Sabha members?
e: 1. Role: Speaker hi sadasyo ke 'Privileges' ka dhyan rakhta hai. \n2. Power: Agar koi bahari insaan House ki insult kare, toh Speaker use saza de sakta hai.

qe: Which fraction of members of Vidhan Parishad are elected by 'Local Bodies' (Panchayats
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 171. \n2. Logic: 1//3 MLAs chunte hain aur 1//3 Local bodies ke elected sadasya chunte hain. \n3. Bihar Fact: Bihar mein 24 sadasya is category se aate hain.

qe: What is the tenure of the 'Deputy Speaker' of Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Logic: Jab tak Vidhan Sabha hai aur wo sadasya hai, tab tak wo Deputy Speaker rahega (Maximum 5 years). \n2. Fact: Wo Speaker ko apna resignation deta hai.

qe: The salary of members of Bihar Legislature is charged on?
o: Consolidated Fund of the State (राज्य की संचित निधि)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 195. \n2. Logic: State Legislature ke kamo ka sara kharch State ke hi khazane (Consolidated Fund) se aata hai.

qe: Under Article 202, the 'Annual Financial Statement' is laid before?
o: The Houses of Legislature (विधानमंडल के सदनों के समक्ष)
e: 1. Budget Rule: Governor ise Assembly (aur Parishad jahan ho) dono ke samne rakhwata hai. \n2. Fact: Money demands par voting sirf Vidhan Sabha mein hoti hai.

qe: Who presides over the 'Joint Sitting' of State Legislature in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye sabse bada 'Hook' hai. Samvidhan mein States ke liye Joint Sitting ka koi pravdhan nahi hai. \n2. Logic: Deadlock hone par Vidhan Sabha ki hi chalti hai.

qe: The 'Chairman' of Vidhan Parishad is elected by?
o: Members of the Council (परिषद के सदस्य)
e: 1. Election: Parishad ke members apne beech se hi ek ko Chairman chunte hain. \n2. Difference: Rajya Sabha mein VP 'Ex-officio' head hota hai, par State Council mein aisa nahi hai.

qe: Can a person be a member of both Bihar Vidhan Sabha and Vidhan Parishad at once?
e: 1. Double Membership: Article 190 ke tehat koi do house ka sadasya nahi ho sakta. Use ek seat chhodni hogi.

qe: Who decides whether a member has incurred 'Disqualification' under the 10th Schedule (Ant-Defection)?
o: The Presiding Officer of the House (सदन का पीठासीन अधिकारी)
e: 1. Power: Sabha mein Speaker aur Parishad mein Chairman decide karta hai. \n2. Judicial Review: Is faisle ko Court mein challenge kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: What is the 'Quorum' for Vidhan Parishad meetings?
e: 1. Logic: Rules sabke liye same hain. Total strength ka 10% sadasya hona zaroori hai.

qe: Which Article allows the Governor to 'Dissolve' the Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Power: 174 ke tehat Governor session bula sakta hai, end kar sakta hai aur House ko dissolve kar sakta hai.

qe: The 'Secretariat' of the State Legislature is provided under which Article?
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Independence. \n2. Logic: Har house ka apna staff aur secretariat hota hai jo sarkar se alag hota hai.

qe: Can the 'Vidhan Parishad' reject a Money Bill?
o: No, only delay by 14 days (नहीं, केवल 14 दिन की देरी)
e: 1. Money Bill Power: Article 198. \n2. Rule: Council na toh ise radd kar sakti hai na badal sakti hai. 14 din baad wo automatically pass mana jata hai.

qe: The 'Pro-tem Speaker' of Bihar Vidhan Sabha is appointed by?
e: 1. Logic: Naye election ke baad jab tak permanent Speaker nahi chuna jata, Governor sabse senior member ko Pro-tem Speaker banata hai.

qe: How many members are elected by 'Local Bodies' in the Bihar Vidhan Parishad?
e: 1. Bihar Data: Total 75 seats mein se 24 seats Local Authority constituencies ke liye hain.

qe: Under Article 203, 'Demands for Grants' can only be made on the recommendation of?
e: 1. Financial Rule: Bina Governor ki sifaarish ke koi bhi 'Demand for Grant' ya 'Money Bill' pesh nahi ho sakta.

qe: The 'Speaker' of Vidhan Sabha has the 'Casting Vote' in case of a tie. Which Article?
e: 1. Casting Vote: Speaker normal halat mein vote nahi deta, par agar barabari (tie) ho jaye, toh wo ek taraf vote dekar faisla karta hai.

qe: In Bihar, the 'Vidhan Sabha' was first constituted in?
e: 1. History: Govt of India Act 1935 ke baad 1937 mein pehla chunav hua tha Bihar mein.

qe: Who decides the 'Finality' of the decision regarding the disqualification of a member on grounds of defection?
o: The Presiding Officer of the House (सदन का पीठासीन अधिकारी)
e: 1. Core Concept: 10th Schedule. \n2. Logic: Vidhan Sabha mein Speaker aur Parishad mein Chairman ka faisla aakhri hota hai. \n3. Post-Mortem: Halanki, 'Kihoto Hollohan case' ke baad is faisle ki Judicial Review ho sakti hai.

qe: Under Article 180, who performs the duties of the Speaker when both Speaker and Deputy Speaker positions are vacant?
o: A member appointed by the Governor (राज्यपाल द्वारा नियुक्त सदस्य)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye 'Pro-tem Speaker' se alag hai. Agar dono pad khali ho jayein, toh Governor kisi bhi MLA ko temporary charge de sakta hai. \n2. Logic: House ka kaam rukna nahi chahiye.

qe: What is the maximum period for which the Vidhan Parishad can delay an 'Ordinary Bill' in the second instance?
e: 1. Hook: Pehli baar mein 3 mahine. \n2. Hustle: Agar Assembly dubara pass karde, toh Parishad sirf 1 mahina aur rok sakti hai. \n3. Total: 3 + 1 = 4 months max.

qe: Article 194 of the Constitution deals with?
o: Powers and Privileges of the House and its members (सदन और उसके सदस्यों की शक्तियाँ और विशेषाधिकार)
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Immunity. \n2. Logic: MLAs ko House ke andar kuch bhi bolne ki azadi milti hai aur unpar koi case nahi ho sakta. \n3. Comparison: Centre mein yahi power Article 105 mein hai.

qe: Who can dissolve the 'Vidhan Parishad' of Bihar?
e: 1. Smart Catch: Vidhan Parishad ek 'Permanent House' hai. Ye kabhi bhang (dissolve) nahi hoti. \n2. Note: Ise 'Abolish' (khatam) kiya ja sakta hai Art 169 mein, par bhang nahi.

qe: Which committee of the Legislature is known as the 'Twin Sister' of the CAG?
e: 1. Relation: PAC CAG ki reports ko audit karti hai. \n2. Logic: Dono milkar sarkar ke kharche par nazar rakhte hain. \n3. Bihar Context: Bihar Vidhan Sabha ki PAC bahut powerful hoti hai.

qe: What is the minimum number of members required to move a 'No-Confidence Motion' in Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
o: As decided by the Rules of the House (सदन के नियमों द्वारा निर्धारित - zyadatar 38-40)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Samvidhan ginti nahi batata, ye 'Rules of Business' tay karte hain. \n2. Bihar Rule: Bihar mein zyadatar total strength ka ek hissa (approx 38-40) support chahiye hota hai.

qe: Under Article 204, no money can be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund without an?
e: 1. Financial Logic: Budget pass hone ke baad 'Appropriation Bill' pass karna mandatory hai, tabhi khazane se paisa nikalta hai. \n2. Fact: Ise 'Power of the Purse' kehte hain.

qe: Who is the 'Ex-officio' Secretary of the State Legislature?
o: Secretary of the Assembly//Council (विधानसभा//परिषद के सचिव)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Har house ka apna independent secretariat hota hai (Art 187). \n2. Independence: Inka staff sarkar (IAS) se alag ho sakta hai.

qe: Can a person be a member of Vidhan Sabha and Parliament at the same time?
e: 1. Rule: Article 190. Agar koi MLA MP ban jata hai, toh use 14 din ke andar ek seat chhodni hogi, nahi toh uski MLA seat khali ho jayegi.

qe: Which Article bars the jurisdiction of Courts in the 'Interim' proceedings of the House?
e: 1. Logic: House ke andar Speaker ne kisi ko chup karaya ya nikaal diya, uspar Court dakhal nahi de sakta. \n2. Ground: 'Irregularity of Procedure' ke adhar par challenge nahi ho sakta.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Business Advisory Committee' of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Rule: Speaker khud is committee ka head hota hai jo House ka 'Timetable' tay karti hai.

qe: A member of the Legislative Council (MLC) can be elected from which field?
e: 1. Composition: 1//3 (Local), 1//12 (Graduates), 1//12 (Teachers), 1//3 (MLAs). \n2. Rest: 1//6 are nominated by Governor.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Time' a State can go without a session of Legislature?
e: 1. Article: 174. \n2. Rule: Do sessions ke beech ka gap 6 mahine se 1 din bhi zyada nahi hona chahiye.

qe: In Bihar, 'Money Bills' can be introduced ONLY in:
e: 1. Financial Rule: Art 198. Money bill hamesha Lower House (Sabha) mein hi aata hai. \n2. Reason: Sabha ke log seedha janata dwara chune jate hain.

qe: Who has the power to decide the 'Salary' of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker?
o: State Legislature by Law (राज्य विधानमंडल कानून बनाकर)
e: 1. Article: 186. \n2. Logic: Parliament ki tarah State Assembly khud apna salary law pass karti hai.

qe: The 'Estimates Committee' (प्राकलन समिति) of the House consists of members from?
e: 1. Technical Rule: Budget se judi is committee mein sirf Lower House ke members hote hain. \n2. Logic: Paiso par asli haq Assembly ka hai.

qe: Under Article 208, who makes the 'Rules of Procedure' for the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Sovereignty: Har House ko apna kaam karne ke rules khud banane ka pura adhikar hai.

qe: What is the minimum 'Strength' of a Vidhan Sabha as per Article 170?
e: 1. Limit: Normal states ke liye 60-500 ki range hai. \n2. Exceptions: Sikkim, Goa jaise chote states mein ye 60 se kam bhi hai.

qe: Who is the 'Guardian' of the Assembly during the session?
e: 1. Power: Speaker hi decide karta hai ki kaun bolega aur kiski baat record mein jayegi.

qe: Can the Governor 'Address' both Houses of Bihar Legislature assembled together?
e: 1. Article: 175. \n2. Session: Governor dono houses ko ek sath bitha kar message de sakta hai.

qe: How many 'Sessions' of the State Legislature are mandatory in a year?
e: 1. Rule: Chunki gap 6 mahine se zyada nahi ho sakta, isliye saal mein 2 baar milna compulsory hai.

qe: The 'Governor' reserves a bill for President under Article 200. Does this apply to Money Bills?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Halanki Governor Money bill ko 'Return' nahi kar sakta, par wo use President ke liye 'Reserve' kar sakta hai (agar wo High Court ko affect kare).

qe: Who was the 'First Chairman' of Bihar Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)?
e: 1. Bihar History: 1912 mein jab Parishad bani, tab Walter Maude iske pehle President (Chairman) the.

qe: In case of a 'Vacant' seat, within how much time must a 'By-election' be held?
e: 1. RPA Act: Election Commission ko 6 mahine ke andar seat bharni hoti hai, jab tak ki Assembly khatam hone mein 1 saal se kam na bacha ho.

qe: Who decides whether a member of Bihar Vidhan Sabha has become 'Unsound Mind'?
o: The Governor (after EC advice) (राज्यपाल - EC की सलाह पर)
e: 1. Logic: Disqualification (Art 191//192) par aakhri sign Governor ka hota hai, Speaker ka nahi (Except defection).

qe: What is 'Guillotine' in Legislative procedure?
o: Putting all remaining demands to vote together (सभी शेष मांगों को एक साथ मतदान के लिए रखना)
e: 1. Hustle: Budget session ke aakhri din, bina behes ke baaki saari demands pass kar di jati hain taaki time bache. Ise Guillotine kehte hain.

qe: The 'Advocate General' can attend Vidhan Sabha session. Can he be sued for what he says there?
o: No, he has immunity (नहीं, उन्हें छूट प्राप्त है)
e: 1. Privilege: Article 194 ki immunity MLAs ki tarah Advocate General ko bhi milti hai.

qe: How many seats are reserved for 'Scheduled Castes' (SC) in the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Bihar Data: Total 243 seats mein se 38 seats SC varg ke liye reserved hain. \n2. Extra Fact: 'Scheduled Tribes' (ST) ke liye sirf 2 seats (Manihari aur Katoria) reserved hain.

qe: Who acts as the 'Speaker Pro-tem' of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
o: The most senior member of the House (सदन का सबसे वरिष्ठ सदस्य)
e: 1. Logic: Naye election ke baad, jab tak permanent Speaker nahi chuna jata, sabse senior member naye MLAs ko shapath dilata hai. \n2. Appointment: Ise Governor appoint karta hai.

qe: Under Article 189, if the votes are equal in Vidhan Sabha, how is the decision made?
o: The Speaker has a 'Casting Vote' (अध्यक्ष के पास निर्णायक मत होता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Casting Vote. \n2. Logic: Speaker pehle vote nahi deta, par 'Tie' hone par wo apna vote dekar faisla karta hai. \n3. Hustle: Ise 'First Instance' vote nahi kaha jata.

qe: Which of the following is NOT a ground for 'Disqualification' of an MLA under Article 191?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Shadi karna ya na karna kanooni akyogyata nahi hai. \n2. Valid Grounds: Labh ka pad, pagalpan, diwaliya hona (Insolvent), aur videshi nagrikta.

qe: A member of Bihar Vidhan Sabha can resign by addressing the resignation to?
e: 1. Rule: MLA apna istifa hamesha Speaker ko deta hai. \n2. Parishad: MLC apna istifa Chairman (Sabha-pati) ko deta hai.

qe: Under Article 202, the 'Annual Financial Statement' (Budget) is laid before the House by?
e: 1. Hook: Budgest pesh Finance Minister karta hai, par kanoonan 'Governor' use rakhwane ke liye zimmedar hota hai. \n2. Logic: Bina Governor ki sifaarish ke budget nahi aa sakta.

qe: What happens if a Bill passed by Vidhan Sabha is 'Rejected' by Vidhan Parishad in Bihar?
o: Vidhan Sabha can pass it again and override (विधानसभा इसे दोबारा पारित कर प्रभावी कर सकती है)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Vidhan Parishad ke paas sirf 'Delay' (rokne) ki power hai. \n2. Power: Agar Sabha dubara pass karde, toh Parishad ki na-manzuri ka koi asar nahi hota.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules of Procedure' for the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Article: 208. \n2. Logic: Har house ko apni maryada aur kam-kaaj ke rules khud banane ka 'Sovereign' power hai.

qe: How many members of Bihar Vidhan Parishad are elected by 'Teachers'?
e: 1. Composition: 1//12 (Graduates) + 1//12 (Teachers). \n2. Condition: In teachers ko kam se kam 3 saal ka padhane ka experience hona chahiye secondary level par.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Advocate General' to speak in the House?
e: 1. Rights: Advocate General (Art 165) ko Art 177 ke tehat House mein baithne aur bolne ka haq hai. \n2. Limit: Wo sadasya nahi hai, isliye 'Vote' nahi de sakta.

qe: Final power to decide on 'Disqualification' on defection ground?
e: 1. 10th Schedule: Speaker ya Chairman hi decide karte hain.

qe: Who appoints the 'Secretary' of the Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
o: The Governor (after consulting Speaker) (राज्यपाल - अध्यक्ष की सलाह पर)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye ek administrative post hai par ispar Governor ka hi sign chalta hai.

qe: Under Article 201, what can the 'President' do with a State Bill?
o: Direct Governor to return it for reconsideration
e: 1. Power: President ke paas state bills par 'Absolute Veto' hota hai. Wo use anant kaal tak rok sakta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Language' to be used in State Legislature?
e: 1. Logic: 120 Parliament ke liye hai, 210 State Legislature ke liye. \n2. Language: Hindi aur English mukhya hain, par Speaker regional language ki ijazat de sakta hai.
